objects.name: GitLab security advisory (AV26-630)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-630 Date: June 24, 2026 On June 24, 2026, GitLab published a security advisory to address vulnerabilities in the following products: GitLab Community Edition (CE) – versions prior to 19.1.1, 19.0.3 and 18.11.6 GitLab Enterprise Edition (EE) – versions prior to 19.1.1, 19.0.3 and 18.11.6 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply the necessary updates. GitLab Patch Release: 19.1.1, 19.0.3, 18.11.6 GitLab Releases
